TITLE: Company
loadError: The company could not be loaded

HINTS.naceCodes: NACE Rev. 2 codes, e.g. 64.19 — type and press Enter.
HINTS.triState: “Unknown” means nobody confirmed it — the analysis then keeps the acts this flag would rule out.
HINTS.activities: What the company does: services, clients, markets.
HINTS.aiDescription: Which AI systems the company uses or builds, and for what.

MARKET.verifiedYes: Yes — every citation was found in the legal corpus
MARKET.verifiedNo: No — not every citation was checked against the legal corpus
MARKET.empty: No classification yet — the assistant sets it in the chat.
MARKET.readOnly: Set by the assistant in the chat; read-only here.

ATTRIBUTES.hint: Free-form data the assistant collects in the chat. Must be a JSON object.

CREDENTIALS.title: Licences, permits and certificates
CREDENTIALS.subtitle: What the company already holds — the analysis checks obligations against these first.
CREDENTIALS.emptyText: Record the licences, permits, registrations and certificates the company holds.

HINTS.scope: Which activities or services it covers
HINTS.claimed: Claimed — stated by the company, nobody checked it.
HINTS.verified: Verified — a person checked it in the issuer's register or against an evidence document.
HINTS.evidence: One of this company's uploaded documents.

CREDENTIALS.verifyText: You confirm that you personally checked this entry — for example in the Bank of Lithuania's or another issuer's public register, or against an evidence document. Who checked it and when is recorded.
CREDENTIALS.unverifyText: The verification stamp (who checked it and when) is removed.
CREDENTIALS.removeText: The entry is removed from the company profile.
CREDENTIALS.dateOrder: The end date cannot be before the start date

STANDARDS.title: Standards
STANDARDS.subtitle: The standards the company is certified to, implements or plans to adopt — every analysis assesses the company against their requirements.
STANDARDS.emptyText: Record the standards the company is certified to, implements or plans to adopt, such as ISO/IEC 27001.
STANDARDS.noneInCorpus: The corpus holds no standards yet. An administrator uploads the licensed copy of a standard on the Corpus page; it can then be added here.
STANDARDS.corpusError: The standards in the corpus could not be loaded
STANDARDS.allAdded: Every standard the corpus holds is already on this list.

HINTS.documentId: One of the standards in the corpus.
HINTS.certified: Certified — a valid certificate covers the scope below.
HINTS.implementing: Implementing — the management system is being built.
HINTS.planned: Planned — the company means to adopt it; a report shows what is still missing.
HINTS.scope: What the management system covers, e.g. the IT services in Vilnius
HINTS.certificate: One of this company's certificates (Licences and credentials tab).

STANDARDS.notReady: Not indexed yet — an analysis skips it
STANDARDS.removeText: The standard is removed from the company profile; later analyses no longer assess it.

DOCUMENTS.title: Documents
DOCUMENTS.subtitle: Internal policies, procedures, contracts and registers — the evidence for the compliance analysis.
DOCUMENTS.dropHint: PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, HTML, CSV or JSON.
DOCUMENTS.emptyText: Upload the company's policies and procedures — the assistant reads them and fills in the company's records from them, and the analysis uses them as evidence.
DOCUMENTS.deleteText: The file and its text are deleted for good. Reports already produced do not change.

INTAKE.message: New documents were uploaded on the company's Documents tab. Read them and bring the company's records up to date.
INTAKE.reading: The assistant is reading the uploaded documents ({count}) and filling in the company's records from them: the profile, the documents' kinds, licences, standards and roles. It takes a few minutes; you can leave this page.
INTAKE.done: The assistant has read the uploaded documents and updated the company's records. What it filed and what it still asks is in the conversation.
INTAKE.failed: The assistant did not finish reading the uploaded documents. {reason}
INTAKE.progress: The assistant is reading the documents

DRAWER.title: Document
DRAWER.noInventory: No inventory yet — it is built during a compliance analysis.
DRAWER.passage: Highlighted: the passage the finding cites as evidence.
DRAWER.criterion: Highlighted: the passage that states the requirement the finding assesses.

ROLES.title: Roles
ROLES.subtitle: Role profiles (e.g. the compliance officer) a chat can adopt as context.
ROLES.emptyText: The assistant saves the roles it finds in the documents you upload, in a chat or on the Documents tab. You can also create one yourself, such as “Compliance officer”.

HINTS.name: E.g. Compliance officer
HINTS.context: Duties, reporting line, independence, conflicts of interest.
HINTS.sources: Which documents and sections the role is drawn from.

ROLES.deleteText: The role is unlinked from the chats that used it.
ROLES.contextTooLong: The context is too long (at most {max} characters)

REPORTS.title: Compliance reports
REPORTS.emptyText: Run a compliance analysis — it determines the applicable acts, assesses the obligations and drafts an action plan.

ACTIONS.title: Action register
ACTIONS.subtitle: Actions from the plans of signed-off reports. The register moves only when a report is signed off: its plan comes in, and earlier actions are checked against its findings.
ACTIONS.loadError: The action register could not be loaded
ACTIONS.emptyText: Sign a finished report off — its action plan will appear here.
ACTIONS.exportLabel: Download the action register as Excel
ACTIONS.replaced: This finding's obligation was replaced since, because its act was read again — a later report cannot confirm it.
ACTIONS.ownRequirement: The policy this requirement comes from was changed and read again since — a later report cannot confirm this finding.
ACTIONS.byHandOnly: No report can confirm this action — only a person closes it, giving the reason in the note.
ACTIONS.doneHint: “Done” means carried out and awaiting the re-test; a later signed-off report that finds the obligations met closes it. A report made after that which still finds an obligation open sends the action back to work.
ACTIONS.closedByReport: A signed-off report closed this action, so its state is not changed by hand. If you disagree with the closure, change the finding in that report — its sign-off is withdrawn and the action goes back to work.

LAW.title: Changes in the law
LAW.subtitle: The acts assessed that changed after the last report ({date}), and the findings worth another look.
LAW.loadError: The changes in the law could not be loaded
LAW.unchanged: The acts assessed have not changed since the last report ({date}).
LAW.unrecorded: The act changed, but which provisions was not recorded.

PROGRAMME.title: Compliance programme
PROGRAMME.subtitle: The documents of the programme are made from the company's documents and its latest compliance report. The AI drafts; only a person approves.
PROGRAMME.loadError: The compliance programme could not be loaded

ABOUT.policy: The top-level compliance document: the eight parts of the policy, the document hierarchy and the missing documents.
ABOUT.governance: Who answers for compliance: the proposed governance structure, the steps of the compliance process and the RACI matrix.
ABOUT.risks: The likelihood and impact criteria, the risk appetite and the register of legal risk scenarios.

GENERATE.title: Generate: {title}
GENERATE.text: The generation runs in the background and takes about five minutes. It spends about {cost} of today's AI budget.
GENERATE.newVersion: A new version ({version}) is made; the earlier versions stay.
GENERATE.missingNeeds: Not generated yet: {kinds}. The document can be generated without them, only it is then less well grounded.

THREADS.title: Related chats
THREADS.subtitle: Your chats linked to this company.

DELETE.title: Delete the company “{name}”?
DELETE.text: The profile, credentials, roles and reports are deleted. Uploaded documents stay in your document list, unlinked from the company.
